children: Ascent Solar’s revenue rose year over year in the third quarter, while its net loss widened. Higher product sales and newly recognized milestone and engineering revenue drove the increase; increased costs, including research and development and share-based compensation, contributed to the larger loss.
¹ Reported as “Total Revenues”. ² Reported as “Net Income/(Loss)”. ³ Reported as “Net Income/(Loss) Per Share (Basic and Diluted)”.
: Product revenue was $148,875, and milestone and engineering revenue was $26,500, compared with $28,549 and zero, respectively, a year earlier.
: Research, development and manufacturing operations costs increased 16% to $719,863, primarily due to higher research and development costs for product and technology improvements.
: The company continued expanding sales and distribution channels and hired a new sales director to accelerate specialty PV application sales and marketing.
: Ascent continued building industrial-scale production capabilities at its Thornton facility while focusing on PV product research and development.
